name: ezlook-anthropic-relay
description: Minimal non-Cloudflare relay for Anthropic API calls. Exists because Cloudflare Workers calling api.anthropic.com (also Cloudflare-fronted) intermittently gets blocked at the Cloudflare edge ("Orange-to-Orange" traffic) with HTTP 403 "forbidden"/"Request not allowed" before the request ever reaches Anthropic. Hosting this relay off Cloudflare (Render) breaks that pattern.
